answer.explanation: From 22:02:26 to 22:04:56 the CompressionFunction logged repeated AccessDenied errors on every s3:PutObject to lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi/compression/*. The error says no identity-based policy allows s3:PutObject for assumed role lambda-rca-bench-CompressionRole-tNi3wsTWkCVs. The target bucket and key prefix match the function's intended output, so the failure is a missing execution-role permission rather than a code or bucket-name fault. The other three functions logged no errors in the window. CloudTrail is not available in this account, so I could not confirm when the policy changed or whether the IaC template is the source.
